novelty: The prior local compiler begins from captured L11/L15 currents, while the upstream atlas leaves non-core attention9 live. This test clamps complete attention9 and every attention/MLP response through MLP14, then predicts the remaining L11/L15 current, c_v, base-pattern response, and c_proj write directly from MLP8 Down and the exact residual lambda products.
registered_interpretation: A pass identifies the literal residual-skip branch of the auxiliary converter. It does not make the distributed MLP correction additive, minimal, or globally task-independent.

opposing_predictions.direct_skip: The full-clamp current equals RMS(base pre-norm plus the MLP8 Down delta times the exact lambda product), and compiled auxiliary responses replay the exact full-clamp arm.
opposing_predictions.hidden_converter: Even after complete attention9 and intervening response clamps, the analytic current or c_v response fails, showing that the apparent remainder depended on an unclamped module or recurrent value branch.

fit_policy: zero fit, zero gradients, literal checkpoint tensors only
